_comment: krita-python scaffold -- EXAMPLE config (a template to adapt, not a live
config). Copy the models block into your own config (~/.jichi or
local/config.json) and fill in your provider/model/apiBase. Secret-free:
the key comes from an env var named by apiKeyEnv, never a literal key here.
A coding-capable chat model is what you want here. Point at a local model
(LM Studio / llama.cpp / Ollama) or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; see
REMEMBER: PyKrita runs INSIDE Krita (the Scripter or an installed plugin),
not with plain python. There is no headless testCommand here -- run scripts
snapshots let you /undo an edit; pathFence keeps writes in this workspace.
